In detail

South-east Rotterdam, including Lombardijen. Rotterdam runs a Veiligheidsindex as part of its Wijkprofiel, built from crime and nuisance figures together with a survey of around 30,000 residents between March and October 2025. Citywide it fell from 110 in 2022 to 104 in 2026, with the perception of safety dropping faster than the recorded figures. Lombardijen is one of the three focus areas whose safety index rose beyond the council's expectations in 2026. Post-war residential, away from anything a visitor comes for.

Rotterdam publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does publish one, Wandroz uses it instead of an assessment. Where a review finds nothing documented, that is recorded as no findings rather than as a safety rating.

Is IJsselmonde safe at night?

At night, IJsselmonde is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Rotterdam. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

IJsselmonde's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Rotterdam) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
